description: This file contains unit tests for the LoanProductPaymentAllocationRuleMerger class, which handles the merging and updating of payment allocation rules within a loan product in the Fineract project. The tests verify adding new rules, updating existing rules, ensuring no changes occur when appropriate, deleting rules, and handling multiple rules.

classes.name: LoanProductPaymentAllocationRuleMergerTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the LoanProductPaymentAllocationRuleMerger, testing rule merging, updating, and deletion logic.

methods.name: createRule
methods.description: Helper method to create LoanProductPaymentAllocationRule instances with specified transaction type, future installment allocation rule, and allocation types.
